patches.why: External GetVariable(FLAG correct_code) in prp_door_future_keypad: movzx ecx,[inst+0xb2] -> mov ecx,1. The door/consumer scripts (ce88d9fe9bdf02d4, cfadc41efdf8e856, ee79d2b57e157978: 'access_granted', 'keypad_sequence_complete', 'numpad_success') read correct_code through this getter via ExternalScriptFlagExpression.

Branch node 0x9f11491f (exec 0x18000e0f0): 'if correct_code -> exec_true else exec_false'. cmp [rcx+0xb2],0 / cmovne rax,rdx -> mov rax,rdx (rdx already = exec_true pin 0x56ccd1bd99a59d3b), so the keypad's own success path always runs.

Bool-expression node 0x18000c030 that feeds correct_code into the graph (refs at 0x18001abf3/0x18001d0ff): movzx eax,[rcx+0xb2] -> mov eax,1. Keeps the internal graph consistent with the two patches above.

evidence: Script 1b9174546ee05f8a.dll = prp_door_future_keypad (echo-symbols). Variable names resolved from the CSymbol64 hashes in its set-by-name function 0x180004b78 against echo-symbols names.tsv: correct_code = 0xff6b4275497911a9 -> bool at instance+0xb2 (Disabled +0xb5, UPDATING +0xb4). Every read of +0xb2 in the DLL: external getter 0x180017cc3, branch node 0x18000e136 (pins exec_true 0x56ccd1bd99a59d3b / exec_false 0x54dc9983c968aa39 resolved by name), bool node 0x18000c071. Only writers are the external SetVariable entry points 0x180018731 / 0x18001923f, i.e. correct_code is assigned from outside (engine/other script) and consumed by the 3 consumer scripts above, which also carry 'evt_internal_keypad_completion'. Node graph: branch 0x9f11491f is reached via a DelayNode (exec 0x180013160) at the end of a chain that starts from a condition node 0x18000ead0. NOT verified: whether the internal branch is evaluated before any digit is entered (in which case the door may open on the first check / first key press rather than after 4 digits) — the patch would then be 'keypad always unlocks' rather than strictly 'any 4 digits'. Also not verified: the 4-character combo comparison itself was not located (it is not in this DLL as code; it appears to happen in engine-side expression evaluation that then sets correct_code externally).
risk: Applies to every keypad that uses prp_door_future_keypad (all 'future' keypad doors), including story keypads; at worst a keypad opens before the full code is typed. No save writes from these patches themselves, but story flags downstream of 'access_granted' may be set earlier than intended. Module hash pinned above; loader must skip on mismatch.
